The complete 20-prompt series for the Mysteries of the Rosary in the style of **Roy de Maistre** uses consistent Cubist-Expressionist geometry, heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, thick oil impasto textures, and his signature "colour-music" harmonic shifts tailored to each set of mysteries.

---

## I. The Joyful Mysteries

*Palette: Luminous ultramarine, gold, rose, emerald green, and warm ochre.*

**1. The Annunciation**

> An oil painting of the Annunciation in the style of Roy de Maistre. On the left, the Archangel Gabriel stands within sharp diagonal shafts of golden and emerald light, wings fractured into overlapping Cubist planes. On the right, the Virgin Mary kneels in solemn prayer, draped in deep ultramarine blue broken by rhythmic geometric facets. A white dove descends along a diagonal beam of light between them. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick oil impasto brushwork, harmonic colour-music palette of sapphire, crimson, gold, and warm ochre, elongated solemn figures, no text.

**2. The Visitation**

> An oil painting of the Visitation in the style of Roy de Maistre. Mary and Elizabeth embrace warmly on an angular hillside pathway, their robes of ultramarine blue, rose, and warm ochre interlocking in rhythmic Cubist planes. Geometric arches and terraced hillsides fracture into emerald green and sunlit gold behind them. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick oil impasto on canvas, harmonic colour-music palette, solemn elongated figures with simplified sculptural faces, no text.

**3. The Nativity**

> An oil painting of the Nativity of Jesus in the style of Roy de Maistre. Inside an angular, timber-framed stable fractured by intersecting diagonal planes, Mary and Joseph kneel in deep blue and burnt sienna robes around the Christ Child lying in a geometric manger. A radiant burst of golden-white light emanates upward from the child, illuminating the surrounding dark facets. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, rich oil impasto brushwork, colour-music palette of ultramarine, gold, ochre, and deep crimson, no text.

**4. The Presentation in the Temple**

> An oil painting of the Presentation of Jesus in the Temple in the style of Roy de Maistre. Beneath soaring, fractured architectural arches of the Jerusalem Temple, the aged Simeon holds the infant Christ aloft in golden light, while Mary and Joseph stand nearby in angular robes of sapphire blue and ochre. Rhythmic vertical columns and diagonal shafts of light divide the composition. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick textured oil paint, harmonic colour-music palette, solemn elongated figures, no text.

**5. The Finding in the Temple**

> An oil painting of the Finding of the Child Jesus in the Temple in the style of Roy de Maistre. Young Jesus sits elevated on geometric stone steps at the centre, gesturing calmly as elders in fractured robes of crimson, emerald, and umber lean in around him. Mary and Joseph enter from the left through angular temple doorways bathed in warm golden light. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick oil impasto on canvas, rhythmic colour-music harmonies, no text.

---

## II. The Luminous Mysteries

*Palette: Brilliant white, radiant amber, turquoise, royal blue, and gold.*

**1. The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan**

> An oil painting of the Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan in the style of Roy de Maistre. Christ stands ankle-deep in angular, crystalline planes of turquoise and royal blue water while John the Baptist pours water from a shell on the rocky bank. Above, the sky fractures into brilliant white and amber shafts of light as a white dove descends vertically. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick oil impasto brushwork, harmonic colour-music palette, solemn elongated figures, no text.

**2. The Wedding at Cana**
*Palette: Brilliant white, radiant amber, turquoise, royal blue, and gold.*
> An oil painting of the Wedding Feast at Cana in the style of Roy de Maistre. At an angular banquet table, Mary gestures toward six large geometric stone water jars in the foreground, whose faceted surfaces shift from cool turquoise to rich ruby-crimson. Christ stands nearby in white and royal blue robes amid fractured architectural arches and warm amber celebration light. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, rich impasto oil texture, rhythmic colour-music palette, no text.

**3. The Proclamation of the Kingdom**
*Palette: Brilliant white, radiant amber, turquoise, royal blue, and gold.*
> An oil painting of Jesus Proclaiming the Kingdom of God in the style of Roy de Maistre. Standing upon a fractured hillside overlooking angular planes of blue sea, Christ raises his hand in teaching, dressed in radiant white and royal blue robes. Surrounding listeners sit in rhythmic Cubist clusters of ochre, emerald, and amber, bathed in warm golden light. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, thick textured oil paint on canvas, harmonic colour-music composition, no text.

**4. The Transfiguration**
*Palette: Brilliant white, radiant amber, turquoise, royal blue, and gold.*
> An oil painting of the Transfiguration on Mount Tabor in the style of Roy de Maistre. Christ stands elevated at the centre in dazzling white and gold robes, dissolved into radiant geometric facets of light, flanked by the solemn figures of Moses and Elijah in angular planes of emerald and ochre. Below, three apostles shield their eyes amidst fractured rocks of deep violet and Prussian blue. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, expressive oil impasto, harmonic colour-music composition, no text.

**5. The Institution of the Eucharist**
*Palette: Brilliant white, radiant amber, turquoise, royal blue, and gold.*
> An oil painting of the Last Supper in the style of Roy de Maistre. Around a sharp diagonal table within a vaulted room of fractured amber and deep blue planes, Christ holds aloft a luminous white host and a golden chalice. The apostles sit in solemn, rhythmic geometric groupings in robes of emerald, ochre, and crimson. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, thick oil impasto brushwork, harmonic colour-music palette, no text.

---

## III. The Sorrowful Mysteries

*Palette: Deep crimson, violet, Prussian blue, burnt umber, and stark slate.*

**1. The Agony in the Garden**
*Palette: Deep crimson, violet, Prussian blue, burnt umber, and stark slate.*

> An oil painting of the Agony in the Garden of Gethsemane in the style of Roy de Maistre. Beneath jagged, nocturnal olive trees fractured into deep Prussian blue and violet planes, Christ kneels in anguished prayer over a sharp angular rock. A slender diagonal beam of pale golden light pierces the dark sky toward him while three apostles sleep in shadowed facets below. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick oil impasto brushwork, sombre colour-music palette, no text.

**2. The Scourging at the Pillar**
*Palette: Deep crimson, violet, Prussian blue, burnt umber, and stark slate.*

> An oil painting of the Scourging at the Pillar in the style of Roy de Maistre. Bound to a monumental vertical stone column at the centre, Christ stands in solemn, elongated sculptural endurance, fractured by harsh diagonal slashes of crimson, slate grey, and burnt umber. Shadowed figures of soldiers flank him in angular geometric planes within a stark courtyard. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, rich textured oil paint on canvas, dramatic colour-music harmonies, no text.

**3. The Crowning with Thorns**
*Palette: Deep crimson, violet, Prussian blue, burnt umber, and stark slate.*

> An oil painting of the Crowning with Thorns in the style of Roy de Maistre. Seated upon an angular stone block, Christ wears a jagged geometric crown of thorns and a heavy robe of fractured deep crimson and violet, holding a slender reed. Mocking soldiers surround him in sharp, intersecting planes of dark bronze and Prussian blue. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick expressive oil impasto, sombre colour-music palette, no text.

**4. The Carrying of the Cross**
*Palette: Deep crimson, violet, Prussian blue, burnt umber, and stark slate.*

> An oil painting of Jesus Carrying the Cross in the style of Roy de Maistre. Along a steep diagonal ascent through fractured stone walls, Christ bends beneath the massive dark timber cross, his robe rendered in deep crimson and violet facets. Beside him, Simon of Cyrene steadies the beam while grieving women in ultramarine and umber kneel along the angular path. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, thick oil impasto brushwork, dramatic colour-music harmonies, no text.

**5. The Crucifixion**
*Palette: Deep crimson, violet, Prussian blue, burnt umber, and stark slate.*

> An oil painting of the Crucifixion in the style of Roy de Maistre. A monumental dark cross anchors the composition, fractured by intersecting diagonal planes of crimson, violet, and brooding midnight blue. Christ on the cross is rendered with solemn, elongated sculptural forms and heavy charcoal outlines, flanked by the abstracted grieving figures of Mary and John in angular robes of ultramarine and deep red. A dramatic burst of golden-white light breaks through the fractured sky behind the cross. Modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred painting, rich impasto oil texture, rhythmic colour-music harmonies, no text.

---

## IV. The Glorious Mysteries

*Palette: Radiant gold, scarlet, cerulean blue, ivory, and emerald.*

**1. The Resurrection**
*Palette: Radiant gold, scarlet, cerulean blue, ivory, and emerald.*

> An oil painting of the Resurrection of Christ in the style of Roy de Maistre. The risen Christ emerges dynamically from an angular stone tomb, surrounded by radiating concentric arcs and sharp Cubist shards of brilliant gold, yellow, and pure white light. Roman soldiers fall back in fractured geometric planes of crimson and dark bronze. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, thick textured oil paint on canvas, luminous colour-music palette, no text.

**2. The Ascension**
*Palette: Radiant gold, scarlet, cerulean blue, ivory, and emerald.*

> An oil painting of the Ascension of Jesus in the style of Roy de Maistre. Elevated high in the upper canvas within swirling geometric arcs of radiant gold, ivory, and cerulean blue, the risen Christ ascends with outstretched arms. Below on an angular green hilltop, Mary and the apostles gaze upward in rhythmic, upward-sweeping Cubist planes of scarlet, ultramarine, and emerald. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, thick oil impasto brushwork, harmonic colour-music palette, no text.

**3. The Descent of the Holy Spirit (Pentecost)**
*Palette: Radiant gold, scarlet, cerulean blue, ivory, and emerald.*

> An oil painting of Pentecost in the style of Roy de Maistre. Inside an architectural upper room fractured into luminous planes of gold, cerulean, and warm ochre, Mary sits at the centre surrounded by the twelve apostles. Above them, a radiant white dove bursts forth in sharp diagonal shards of scarlet and golden flame descending toward each figure. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, thick oil impasto on canvas, triumphant colour-music palette, no text.

**4. The Assumption of Mary**
*Palette: Radiant gold, scarlet, cerulean blue, ivory, and emerald.*

> An oil painting of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary in the style of Roy de Maistre. Draped in flowing geometric facets of cerulean blue and ivory white, Mary rises weightlessly through soaring diagonal beams of radiant gold and rose light, surrounded by abstracted, angular angelic forms. Below, an empty stone tomb rests amidst emerald and ochre facets. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred art, rich impasto oil texture, harmonic colour-music palette, no text.

**5. The Coronation of Mary**
*Palette: Radiant gold, scarlet, cerulean blue, ivory, and emerald.*

> An oil painting of the Coronation of Mary as Queen of Heaven in the style of Roy de Maistre. Enthroned amidst monumental concentric circles and fractured Cubist planes of gold, scarlet, and royal ultramarine, Mary bows serenely as Christ places a geometric golden crown upon her head, with a radiant white dove hovering above. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, modernist Cubist-Expressionist liturgical art, thick oil impasto brushwork, triumphant colour-music harmonies, no text.

An oil painting of the opening of the Holy Rosary in a modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred style. At the centre, a tall, solemn crucifix with the elongated sculptural figure of Christ, rendered in fractured geometric planes of ivory, ochre and deep crimson. A complete rosary hangs from the foot of the cross and loops down across the foreground: the five-bead chain, the medal and the circle of beads all clearly visible, each bead a faceted jewel of ultramarine and gold. Behind the cross, rhythmic diagonal shafts of golden-white light break the sky into sapphire, emerald and rose planes, suggesting the Holy Trinity with three overlapping concentric arcs. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, thick oil impasto brushwork, harmonic colour-music palette of ultramarine, gold, crimson and warm ochre, calm and prayerful, 3:4 portrait orientation, no text, no lettering, no signature, no watermark.

An oil painting of the Hail, Holy Queen in a modernist Cubist-Expressionist sacred style. Mary stands crowned as Queen of Heaven and Mother of Mercy, tall and serene, her arms opened wide so that her great mantle of fractured ultramarine and ivory planes spreads out to shelter a small kneeling crowd of men, women and children in angular robes of ochre, emerald and crimson. A rosary hangs from her right hand. Above her head, a geometric golden crown and a halo of twelve faceted stars; behind her, radiating concentric arcs of gold, rose and cerulean light. Below, the kneeling figures look up to her with clasped hands. Heavy charcoal-black structural outlines, thick oil impasto brushwork, triumphant colour-music palette of gold, ultramarine, scarlet and ivory, tender and majestic, 3:4 portrait orientation, no text, no lettering, no signature, no watermark.
